scenes.brief: Show Figma logo with tagline 'Design Together' as opening title.
Animated b-roll of diverse designers collaborating in real-time on a Figma file, with camera moving across the canvas.
Still hero shot of the Figma interface highlighting layers, assets, and design panels.
Simple kinetic text displaying 'Over 4 million designers use Figma worldwide' with subtle motion.
User drags a frame onto the canvas and converts it into a component, showing the inline edit.
Display call-to-action 'Start designing for free at figma.com' with Figma logo.

beats.text: Welcome to Figma, where teams design together.
Designers from around the world collaborate live, sharing ideas instantly on the canvas.
The Figma interface puts layers, assets, and panels at your fingertips for seamless design.
Over four million designers use Figma to bring ideas to life.
Drag a frame onto the canvas, then turn it into a reusable component with a click.
Start designing for free at figma.com.
